custom_llm_guide.title: Custom LLM Integration
custom_llm_guide.description: This guide explains how to integrate custom Large Language Models (LLMs) into the simulation using PyTorch (.pt) or TensorFlow (.h5) files. Follow these steps to upload and use your custom models in the system.

steps.title: Step 1: Prepare Your LLM Model
content: Ensure your custom LLM is saved in the appropriate format:
Your model should be ready for inference (evaluation mode for PyTorch).

steps.title: Step 2: Upload Your LLM Model
content: Go to the model upload section on the website.
Select the 'Custom' option under your team (Red or Blue) from the dropdown menu.
Upload your model file in the `.pt` or `.h5` format.
Ensure the file is correctly named:
- For the Blue team, use `blue_custom_model.pt` or `blue_custom_model.h5`.
- For the Red team, use `red_custom_model.pt` or `red_custom_model.h5`.

steps.title: Step 3: Integration with the Simulation
content: Once uploaded, the system will automatically detect your model file and integrate it into the simulation.
The backend will recognize and use the custom model for generating messages and computing potency values during the simulation.

steps.title: Step 4: Verify Model Usage
content: During the simulation, the system will show the model being used for message generation.
You can verify that your custom model is being used by checking the console logs or output messages, which will indicate if the 'Custom' model is applied.

steps.title: Step 5: Update or Replace Your Model
content: To update or replace your custom LLM, upload a new `.pt` or `.h5` file following the same process outlined above.
Ensure the model file has the correct naming convention (e.g., `blue_custom_model.pt` or `red_custom_model.h5`).
